decision: Document preparation capacity with a 12-week mobilisation ramp (30 % at NTP): piping 32 (incl. 3D area modelling; minimum found 31, one FTE margin), I&C 14, civil 30, process 12, electrical 8, mechanical 12 (incl. mechanical design criteria), structural 18, commissioning 3, package engineering (general) 5, HVAC 7, HSE 3, project control 1 FTE (145 FTE, 7.5 h / day). Checking is included in the document hours; site support and vendor expediting are staffed separately.
rationale: Smallest staffing found (trial levelling) with no negative EWP or PWP float for the Rev B MDL (about 185,000 EPC hours); the Rev A staffing of 43 FTE (DEC-EPCE-0007) was sized on an MDL that missed about 75 % of the work.
title: Engineering staffing for the Rev B MDL (document preparation, levelled timeline)
